meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service
meta.revisionPolicy: Bank-wise figures are the banks' own returns as the RBI publishes them and are not revised once printed; the Outlook's latest March is provisional and is replaced by the next edition's figure. Mergers are disclosed on the acquirer, never joined.
meta.coverage: Each bank group's and each bank's share of all scheduled commercial banks' deposits, advances and assets, every quarter
meta.note: Derived from RBI DBIE report 1221, table 1 (banks-balance-sheet and banks-groups-balance-sheet): the bank's or group's figure divided by all scheduled commercial banks', domestic operations (offices in India), in per cent. A bank's share jumps when it absorbs another (see each series' mergerNote).
